draft: The streets of Mexico City under a clear blue sky come alive with solar-powered trams gliding along boulevards lined with fruit trees and flowers. Neighbors exchange produce at the weekly tianguis, discussing hydroponic tips from the local community center. People gather to learn about cooperative credit systems that have made home ownership more equitable across the city. Trust in open-door ministries has kept civic society thriving. Small businesses thrive alongside co-ops and mutual aid networks. Drones overhead are unremarked as trust is high, streets safe, open and full of potential. Mutual aid networks exchange resources freely, solar power is widespread, crime rates low. This scenario allows for a cooperative atmosphere where mutual aid and commons can flourish.
